releaseNotes: AURA 3.9.8: Auto-Mix recommendations now fill the tab as an even two-column grid so every mapped stem is visible without scrolling (click any row for its Peak/target/RMS detail). A Reset Layout button in Settings restores the draggable panel sizes to their defaults. New opt-in AURA Assist applies a gentle corrective EQ to the master output: one-click Match to Target nudges the 8 EQ bands toward the selected genre's target curve, with a wet/dry mix and a Flat reset. Assist is OFF by default - AURA does not touch your audio unless you enable it, and it processes on the Master instance only. Fully close the DAW before installing.
